standard_prerequisites: Context span 5280-5285: R any non-Noetherian ring, I an ideal that is not finitely generated, S = R[x, y]/xyI graded with x, y of degree 1; X = Proj(S) is a projective scheme over R; the claim is that H^0(X, O_X) is not a finitely generated R-module

Context span 5287-5325: decomposing S_x, S_y, S_{xy} by bidegree gives summands R'_{a,b} (R for b = 0, R/I for b != 0), R''_{a,b} (R for a = 0, R/I for a != 0), and R/I in every bidegree; H^0(X, O_X) is the kernel of (S_x)_0 x (S_y)_0 -> (S_{xy})_0, (F, G) -> F - G, which by the explicit descriptions is the submodule M of R^2 of pairs with F - G in I; the surjection M -> I given by (F, G) -> F - G shows M is not finitely generated

Context span 5327-5332: the surjection R[x, y] -> S gives a closed immersion i: X -> P^1_R; F = i_*O_X is a finite type quasi-coherent module on P^1_R whose H^0 equals the non-finitely generated module M
core_obligations: Item 1: X = Proj(S) is a projective scheme over the ring R with H^0(X, O_X) = M not finitely generated (context kernel computation)
Item 2: F = i_*O_X is a finite type quasi-coherent module on P^1_R with H^0(P^1_R, F) = H^0(X, O_X) = M not finitely generated (context)

Run the context bidegree/kernel computation for M
Conclude both items, the second via the context closed immersion
